subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): bound auth-profile JSON reads with size cap

question: Should existing auth-profile stores larger than 10 MiB be intentionally treated as unavailable with the existing null/no-credentials flow, or should the cap surface a distinct recoverable diagnostic or use a different bounded policy?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound and its stated behavior is covered, but choosing a hard limit and silent handling for persisted credential stores changes upgrade behavior and is a product/security-boundary choice rather than a testable implementation detail.

options.title: Accept the 10 MiB bounded-store contract
options.body: Land the PR with the existing null-return behavior, accepting that oversized stored profiles are intentionally skipped to prevent unbounded memory reads.

options.title: Require a distinct recovery diagnostic
options.body: Keep the bounded read but add an explicit user-facing diagnostic or Doctor recovery path for an oversized persisted auth store before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 10 MiB bounded-store contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the existing null-return behavior, accepting that oversized stored profiles are intentionally skipped to prevent unbounded memory reads.
